mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are mainly clear near Verona City Hall under a waning crescent moon. Temperatures will drop to an overnight low of 32 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

The Plan Commission is reviewing new development projects this coming Monday at City Hall, and the Public Works department reminds residents to stay updated on street maintenance by subscribing to the city newsletter.

The local scene is busy with live music at Bailey's Run tomorrow, plus live music and events at Lake Lou-ee and Paddy Mac's also set for tomorrow. Looking further ahead, the Dane County Farmers Market returns this Saturday.
On October 25, officers located a 40-year-old Verona man at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue who was arrested for O W I, first offence.
Today's flavor was Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is now closed for the night, but we look forward to serving you tomorrow's flavor, Chocolate Volcano, when we open at 10:00 AM.
